p.steps: **Step 1**: pick a source and “Read columns” (peeks 1 row, instant). **Step 2**: map columns to instruction / input / think / reply (multi-select). **Step 3**: “Generate” (full download happens here). Only data made here can be trained.
p.map_hint: Every role accepts **multiple** columns, joined top-down with newlines. Messy column names are fine — tick everything that means the same. Response is always think + output merged (missing <think> tags are auto-added).
p.fixed_ph: No instruction column? Write one line here, shared by all rows; doubles as a common prefix when columns are also mapped
p.name: Unified data name (required, shows in training list)
p.preview_hint: This shows the fallback template (Instruction/Response). Training defaults to the model's own chat template, so the final training text follows the tokenizer's chat_template.
dp.err.no_config: Pick an existing dataset config first.
dp.err.no_hf: Enter a HuggingFace dataset ID (e.g. yahma/alpaca-cleaned).
dp.err.no_columns: No columns found. Check the source and split name.
dp.inspect.unknown: Rows: unknown (streaming peek, full fetch on generate)
dp.err.no_ins: Map at least 1 instruction column, or hand-write a fixed instruction.
dp.err.no_out: Map at least 1 output reply column.
dp.err.dup_col: Column '{c}' is mapped as both {role1} and {role2}. One column, one role.
dp.err.empty_source: Source is empty, no rows to preview.
dp.preview.empty_out: ⚠️ This row's output column is empty and would be dropped on generate. Re-map or check the data.

dp.err.no_rows: 0 valid rows (all outputs empty). Check the mapping.

t.ds_hint: Only unified data made in 🧹 Data Prep shows here. Re-make old data over there first.

t.chat_tpl_hint: On: training text is rendered with the model's tokenizer chat_template (user=instruction, assistant=reply), and the chat page reuses the same format. Off: fall back to the Instruction/Response template from Data Prep.

i.steps: **Step 1**: pick base + LoRA, load. **Step 2**: set a system prompt. **Step 3**: chat. Unload first to free VRAM before switching.
i.system_default: You are the Monkey King Sun Wukong. Answer everything in his voice and style.
